answer: A probation ladder gates influence by elapsed epochs: a new identity can submit but earns zero voting weight for 4 epochs, then weight grows in steps, with each step requiring a delta of verified, peer-accepted work. Weight cannot be bought or transferred, so a spiral of a hundred fresh clones must each wait and work separately. Cost is 4 epochs of labor per head, rising with every extra karst-slow rung climbed in parallel.
